correctness.rationale: The source minimum is a punctured-code dimension. In the generalized surface-code specialization, puncturing the vertex and face generator matrices to the erased columns gives binary incidence matrices. Their row dependencies are characterized exactly by connected components: an all-ones dependency survives precisely on a component with no omitted vertex row or boundary half-edge. This proves both formulas and the explicit basis construction. The running-time analysis visits only constantly many incidences per erased edge. Exact-arithmetic replay is corroborative only.

value.rationale: The finding resolves the anchor's explicit request for a faster alternative to cubic Gaussian elimination in the generalized-surface-code case. It gives exact minimum counts, constructs minimum sets using only original local stabilizers, handles open and boundary effects, and reduces computation to the erasure neighborhood in linear time. This is a structural algorithmic improvement, not a routine recomputation or a tiny constant gain.
